title: super fertilizer
description: A fertilizer on which almost all plant crops can be grown instantly.
body:
This simple mod will add fertilizer that can grow plants in Minecraft.
> Specifications
- The fertilizer has a simple craft:
![Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dd9824f1209d1d9914f67dffa90d1386ee5f51f.png)
- It can grow almost all plant crops:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d950603f4b0762ef5f0bcb8760cbfa69ef6c8a2.png)
- It has 60 uses, which adds balance
